svg.aria-label: One convention replaced, fifty-seven years apart
svg.text: One convention replaced, fifty-seven years apart
In force, and it stayed in force
In force — fifty-seven years after the first signature
And the two countries start on different days
UK, income and capital gains · 6 April 2026
HMRC's own manual carries both, with the note that the previous one applied until the new one took effect.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 8 September 2026
